svg.title: ARMOR-STUDIO architecture
svg.desc: The browser loads the app as static files from the small static host or from the nginx of the image. The app calls ARMOR-SERVER with an HttpOnly session for JSON, WebSocket events and MJPEG video, and checks what it receives against a copy of the types generated by ARMOR-COMMON. The static host also publishes the address of the server in armor-config.json, so one build can start against any server.
